mobile_ux_issues: Homepage contains zero embedded lead capture forms; clicking 'Book service online' redirects visitors off-page to /contact.html
Dedicated /contact.html relies on a static 7-field text form (Name, Phone, Email, ZIP, Street Address, Service dropdown, Notes) with no interactive roof price estimator or material tier preview
Header and contact page display two different 813 phone numbers ((813) 690-3296 vs. (813) 982-0218), creating avoidable mobile click-to-call confusion
seo_or_speed_leaks: Header brand logo loads an oversized 1395x1117 PNG file with an empty alt='' attribute
13 of 23 homepage images have missing or empty alt attributes, and 6 images omit loading='lazy'
Homepage hero targets Tampa, FL while service cards immediately below repeat 'in Dover', diluting core Tampa roof replacement relevance alongside a 1,107 ms initial server response
technical_audit.current_lead_capture_method: Off-page redirect from homepage CTAs to a static 7-field form on /contact.html plus click-to-call phone links

trojan_horse_angle.pitch_hook_english: Your Tampa site showcases 37+ years of family-owned credibility, but homeowners on the homepage have no instant roof estimator and get sent off-page to a static 7-field contact form before seeing any ballpark pricing.
